title: Foundations
description: The piano layout and your first chord.

lessons.title: Meet the Piano
lessons.subtitle: Find Middle C and play your first sound.
lessons.complete: Nice! You found Middle C and heard your first chord. 20 XP earned.

segments.text: Hello! I am your AI piano instructor.
Our goal is simple: play real songs you love. The secret? Chords. Chords first.
But before chords, let me show you something beautiful.
That is a C Major 7 chord. Four notes, one moment. Already beautiful.
A piano has only seven letter names. A B C D E F G. Then it repeats.
Every glowing key here is a C. Same note, different octave.
C is always to the LEFT of the group of two black keys. That is your anchor.
Your first chord. C Major. Thumb on C, middle finger on E, pinky on G.

lessons.title: The 1-3-5 Pattern
lessons.subtitle: Skip a finger. That's a chord.
lessons.complete: You just learned the 1-3-5 chord shape. Every major chord uses it. 25 XP earned.

segments.text: Instead of playing every note in a row, we skip a finger.
